context.content: That many brews is a VERY bad idea and even worse without overloads. No wonder you struggle with the fight, with that many brews your stats will be utter shit. Considering you are very low on cash you should never have used brews in the first place, waste of money. Rather fail with sharks/rocktails than loose 500k in brews. Hybrid armor is just really terrible for single style combat. No damage bonus and much lower defense than single style armor of the same level. What defender/shield do you have? Resonance, revenge and deflect make the fight a lot easier
